title: polylineTube
body:
## polylineTube

Sweeps a round tube of the given radius along straight segments between explicit 3D points, using a temporary native Blender POLY curve with a bevel that is converted to mesh and then discarded. Points are in the node's local coordinates and centre moves the whole tube. Choose it for pipes, wires, streamline-like paths or trajectories you can list inline; use curveFromCSV when the points come from a table.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Consecutive duplicate points create zero-length segments and fail with INVALID_GEOMETRY.
- A closed tube needs at least three points.
- The adaptor's recorded native qualification cases cover only a material on a cube; this operation relies on repository examples, not on a recorded qualification case.

Native binding: `polylineTube`. Output kind: `["data"]`.

| Input port | Multiplicity | Required | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `material` | one node | yes | `material` |

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `points` | Ordered path vertices [[x, y, z], ...] joined by straight segments in list order; the tube follows them exactly, without spline smoothing. Coordinates are relative to centre. Between 2 and 1024 points, each component within +/-100000. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number","minimum":-100000,"maximum":100000},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3},"minItems":2,"maxItems":1024}` | **required** |
| `radius` | Radius of the tube swept along the path (Blender curve bevel_depth). | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true}` | `0.05` |
| `resolution` | Number of segments in each quarter circle of the tube cross-section (Blender bevel_resolution). 0 gives the coarsest, diamond-like section; higher values make the tube rounder and add faces. | `{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"maximum":8}` | `3` |
| `closed` | When true the path is cyclic: a final segment joins the last point back to the first, giving a ring-shaped tube without ends. Closed paths need at least three points. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `false` |
| `caps` | When true the two open ends of the tube are filled (Blender use_fill_caps), giving a closed volume suitable for STL publication or boolean; when false the ends stay open. It has no effect on a closed path. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `true` |
| `centre` | World position [x, y, z] of the object origin; every listed point is offset by it. Schemaxis assigns it as the object's location, so the mesh itself stays about the local origin and later modifiers that work about that origin (mirror, bend, twist) use this point. Keep it at [0, 0, 0] when the points are already world positions. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number"},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | `[0,0,0]` |
| `smoothShading` | When true, every face of the generated polylineTube is marked smooth so Blender interpolates normals and the tessellated surface renders without visible facets; when false the faces render flat. Geometry and vertex positions are identical either way. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `false` |
